cfg="$HOME/Library/Application Support/rtk/config.toml"; eq=$(python3 -c "import tomllib,sys;host=tomllib.load(open(sys.argv[1],'rb'))['hooks']['exclude_commands'];fix=tomllib.load(open(sys.argv[2],'rb'))['hooks']['exclude_commands'];print(len(host),host==fix)" "$cfg" fixtures/rtk-hook-exclusions.toml)
eq_bool=$(printf '%s' "$eq" | awk '{print $NF}')
d=$(mktemp); bad=0
while IFS= read -r c; do
  out=$(rtk hook check "$c" 2>&1); rc=$?
  if printf "%s" "$out" | grep -qF "No rewrite for: $c" && [ "$rc" -eq 1 ]; then
    status=OK
  else
    status=MISMATCH; bad=1
  fi
  printf 'probe [%s] -> %s (exit %s) [%s]\n' "$c" "$out" "$rc" "$status" >> "$d"
done <<'PROBES'
git show HEAD:x | tail -n 5
diff a.txt missing.txt
git -C repo show HEAD:x
git branch -a
jq -r .x f.json
PROBES
echo "RTK_HOOK_PROBES host_config_entries,equals_fixture=$eq mismatches=$bad (5 probes, 0 mismatches expected; comparison now asserted below, not just printed)"
echo "host rtk config (not a repository fixture): $cfg"
cat "$d"
rm -f "$d"
test "$bad" -eq 0 && test "$eq_bool" = "True" && echo "asserted: 0 probe mismatches and the host rtk config's exclude_commands list equals fixtures/rtk-hook-exclusions.toml"
